author: S3M3L
body:
Reported Player(s): EricV4
Rules Broken: Since I started to play on Avicus (A week ago), this player is accusing me of hacking every game I play, at least ten games now. I have reported a couple of times and a moderator (no namedroping) got on but nothing was done about it. It's a bit annoying not being able to play when I'm being attacked by a specific player everytime I join, and it seems like my reports in-game isn't taken serious.
Evidence: See screenshot.


http://i.imgur.com/8rbRJKn.png

replies.body:
Hey S3M3L! This would only be enough for a warn/kick.

I'll leave this open if you'd like to discuss anything further.

replies.body:
Hey S3M3L!

We'll keep an eye on him.
Have a nice day! Take care.

replies.body: Thank you guys for answering me. It has happened at least ten times as I wrote in my first post, I feel I have been harassed as he's even laughing at me while the moderator online wasn't doing anything about it. I want someone to take action, thank you.

replies.body: I've just sent him a message asking him to stop. If he continues to do it, please file another player report with evidence and a more severe punishment will take place.

replies.author: Mooch24
replies.body:
I sent him a Skype message telling him to refrain from harassing players and accusing them of hacking.

The evidence given was only enough for a warning. The only time warnings can be given is when he's seen breaking the rules in-game not via forum report.

replies.author: S3M3L
replies.body:
It doesn't make sense to me, when I report in-game you say I have to report in the forums in order for an action to be taken. Now you are saying a report here isn't enough and I have to report in-game. What happened to my ten + reports in-game, didn't they count as well?

No, I hope it doesn't happen again and I am thankful you helped me out.

replies.author: Eklip_Z
replies.body: Online reports have an extremely high chance of being replied to so if you see a player breaking the rules, you have reported them in game but no Moderator has come (you can check with /list,) report them on the forums with evidence to ensure a player is punished for it.
